macros.name: AddAllocatedToUpdateMarksList
macros.doc: The function add all mark classes allocated by \newmarks and \NewMarkClass to automatical updating list.

macros.name: ExtractSplitMarks
macros.doc: This command is used after a \vsplit, and save first marks and last marks of specified mark classes which are directly presented in being split part if these marks is not total empty.

macros.name: UpdateMarks
macros.doc: Reinserting saved first marks and last marks of specified mark classes (if have been saved) into the current box, or if not in a box then the main vertical list.
